title: A click in a text field places the cursor
body:
A click on the prompt box or on a form's text field does nothing today. The keyboard is the only way to move the cursor.

## Proposal

- A click inside a text field moves its cursor to the character under the pointer. A click past the end of a row moves it to the end of that row. A click below the last row moves it to the end of the text.
- The mapping from a screen position to a byte uses the row ranges that `TextField` gives back from its layout, so the prompt and form fields share it.
- A click on a form text field also moves the form's cursor to that field.
